column1: # SYNTHETIC IP->network map for trailwatch. Every range is reserved address space
# (RFC 6598 shared space 100.64.0.0/10 and RFC 2544 benchmarking space 198.18.0.0/15) and every
# ASN is from the private-use range 64512-65534. Organisation names are invented. Coordinates are
# the public city-centre coordinates of the named city. Do not use for real-world attribution.
